reported_success.location: Article p. 2, Results, paragraph naming EFCAB4B, LINC01171 and MORN2
reported_success.quote: Only three snps of 50 remained, on genes EFCAB4B, ... LINC01171, and MORN2, that could be shown to meet the ... original criterion of at least double in CFS patients compared to ... a comparable 23andMe control, all hovering at a ratio of about ... 2.0.

notes:
Titles and DOIs verified from the primary PDF title pages. Original table is p. 5; replication Table 1 is p. 3 (the supplied replication p. 5 locator does not exist in the four-page article). Both print frequency ratios, not odds ratios; printed metrics retained without conversion. No SNP-specific p-values are printed. Original total cohort of 383 is not used as analytic n because SNP-specific denominators cannot be established. Replication n is the printed per-SNP control participant count only, not a combined case-control n. Replication author-derived table ratios use the original reported case frequencies with new controls; ALFA is a separate comparison. Success follows the authors' gene-specific narrative verdict, not a significance inference. ALFA ratio is 1.80, below two, although the authors' narrative includes EFCAB4B among the three remaining genes.
